description: This file contains test cases for functions related to building and resolving Telegram interactive buttons, using the Vitest testing framework.

methods.name: buildTelegramInteractiveButtons
methods.description: Constructs Telegram inline button rows from a given blocks structure containing buttons and select options.

methods.name: resolveTelegramInlineButtons
methods.description: Determines the set of inline buttons to use, preferring explicitly provided buttons over derived ones from interactive blocks.

ctags.name: explicit
